row.name: Force Mind Trick
row.effect: Plant a simple, non-harmful suggestion in one non-Force-sensitive being within 5 feet. Requires a Quick Contest of skill vs. Will.

levels.name: Force Mind Trick
levels.description: The Force-user subtly influences the minds of others, planting suggestions, causing confusion, or altering perceptions.
levels.effect: Plant a simple, non-harmful suggestion in one non-Force-sensitive being within 5 feet. Requires a Quick Contest of skill vs. Will.
